outcome: maternal preferences for labor pain relief methods
utilization of labor pain relief methods
perceived effectiveness of pain relief measures
cohort: The study included 512 low-risk women who remained low-risk until admission in labor and completed the study.
finding: Hydrotherapy and unmedicated labor were favored by a majority of subjects, and all pain relief measures were rated above average in effectiveness.
mod_finding: Hydrotherapy use was higher among women undergoing water birth deliveries.
